comment: Parameter indices 32 to 47, 56 to 71 and 88 to 91 are configured with no name and no panel position; they are not drawn on the panel and have no line. The amount and radius sliders on each channel are drawn by the module rather than being parameters. The maker's tooltip calls the per-input OUT jack a direct output of the channel's audio, while the manual says it is scaled by the amount and by the distances to the mix ports; the manual's account is used here. The second Fold entry on the OUT-port menu is printed with the same text as the first, Fold 0..10V, but the code folds it at -5V to 5V; this looks like a duplicated label in the maker's menu map and is worth reporting upstream. The x and y CV inputs on the IN channels and on the MIX channels read 0 to 10V by default; each port carries a menu option that offsets the voltage by half its span, which makes it a -5 to 5V input instead. The sequence-select input expects a trigger in the five trigger modes, 1V per twelve sequences in C4 and a 0 to 10V ramp across the sequences in VOLT.
